name: imav22_static_full_seed_22_fidelity_v3
fidelity: CrazySim port of the accepted Isaac Lab visual-fidelity-v3 seed-22 reconstruction

static.objects: two gates and eight fixed obstacles

dynamic.objects: two fixed gates and eight obstacles; one non-gate obstacle relocates per 30-second event

gate_specification.visual: UV-preserving OBJ conversion of the pinned official imav2022-gate.dae

panel.feet: two 0.43 x 0.10 x 0.07 m feet with supports

layout.claim: deterministic seeded reconstruction; final competition coordinates were not published

venue.floor: 8 x 8 m green turf; black north/south and blue east/west one-metre strips
venue.background: 2.6 m curtain perimeter, north/east netting to 3.4 m, four padded posts, cabinet and visual-only traffic rug

camera_contract.note: The CrazySim vehicle camera remains the policy input; scene cameras use the corresponding square-sensor field of view.

dynamic_obstacle_contract: All eight non-gate objects are mocap bodies. Dynamic mode cycles one object per event toward deterministic poses generated by the Isaac seed-22 relocation sampler for a drone at the origin with yaw zero, smoothly interpolates position and yaw, and requires base clearance plus object footprint radius along the complete path.

extended.purpose: Out-of-distribution robustness only; not an official scoring configuration
